partialAlignments.qualification: Business & Economy in the Age of AI provides a partial contribution to an important and identifiable part of Introduction to Business Analytics' subject, how business and data or AI connect, including AI's capabilities and limits, privacy and ethics through business cases; it does not teach the introductory data-analytic techniques (clustering, prediction, visualisation) or the group case project of that component.

Mathematical Methods provides a partial contribution to the calculus and mathematical-modelling half of Mathematics and Statistics 1 (differentiation, integration and applied modelling projects); its statistics half (descriptive statistics, probability and sampling) is covered by other UCR courses on separate rows.

Linear Algebra provides a partial contribution to the linear-algebra half of Mathematics and Statistics 2 (matrices, systems of linear equations, vector spaces and transformations); the statistical-inference half is covered by other UCR courses on separate rows.
Introduction to Programming provides related taught content for the target's Fundamentals of Programming: Python, data types, control structures, and the steps from problem to implemented programme.

Database Management Systems provides related taught content for relational database design, SQL querying and query processing, the core of the target's Database Management; its managerial and non-relational topics are not specifically covered.

Search, constraint satisfaction and optimisation projects include linear and nonlinear programming. This is a partial computational contribution, not the complete target modelling curriculum, integer programming, maximum-flow, simplex and business-specific techniques.

Introduction to Data Science provides a partial contribution to the data cleaning, exploration and visualisation of Knowledge Discovery and Data Visualization; the data-mining methods and model-evaluation techniques of that component are covered mainly by Machine Learning.

Machine Learning provides related taught content for the supervised and unsupervised learning, classification and tree-based methods of the target's Machine Learning; the target's neural-network topics continue in the separate Neural Networks & Deep Learning course.

AI Ethics provides a partial contribution to the ethics, privacy, fairness and accountability parts of Responsible Data Use; the target's legal and data-protection element is not covered by any scheduled UCR course.

Introduction to Economics provides a partial contribution to Data-Driven Decision Theory's consumer and producer theory, market structures and game theory; the target's revealed-preference and behavioural-economics topics are not specifically covered.

Marketing & Consumer Engagement provides a partial contribution to the marketing concepts, strategy and functions of Marketing and Business Analytics; the target's data-driven segmentation, response-model and conjoint methods are not specifically covered.

Money, Banking & Finance provides a partial contribution to the financial decision-making and risk-assessment part of Financial Analysis and Risk Management; UCR does not evidence the valuation theory, portfolio theory and derivatives of that component.

Accounting & Corporate Finance provides a partial contribution to the financial-statement and accounting-theory part of Accounting and Technology; the data-analytics-in-accounting element is not covered.
